words.definition: A competition in which many players or teams compete against each other in a series of games or matches.
words.example_en: Our school football team won the tournament last weekend.
words.example_sk: Náš školský futbalový tím vyhral minulý víkend turnaj.

words.definition: A person who trains, teaches, or guides someone, especially in sports or personal development.
words.example_en: Her coach helped her improve her running technique.
words.example_sk: Jej tréner jej pomohol zlepšiť techniku behu.

words.definition: A person who is trained or skilled in sports, exercises, or games requiring physical strength, speed, or endurance.
words.example_en: She is a talented athlete who trains every day.
words.example_sk: Je talentovaná atlétka, ktorá trénuje každý deň.

words.definition: To try to be more successful or better than someone else in a contest, activity, or situation.
words.example_en: Many athletes compete in international events every year.
words.example_sk: Mnohí športovci súťažia každý rok na medzinárodných podujatiach.

words.definition: A series of connected railway carriages that travels on tracks and carries passengers or goods.
words.example_en: We took the train to the city.
words.example_sk: Išli sme do mesta vlakom.

words.definition: Success in a competition, battle, or struggle; the act of winning.
words.example_en: The team celebrated their victory after the final match.
words.example_sk: Tím oslavoval svoje víťazstvo po finálnom zápase.

words.definition: Doing things energetically; involved in action or activity.
words.example_en: She is very active and plays sports every day.
words.example_sk: Je veľmi aktívna a každý deň športuje.

words.definition: To be the right size or shape for something or someone; also, being healthy and in good physical condition.
words.example_en: These shoes fit me well, and I want to stay fit by exercising every day.
words.example_sk: Tieto topánky mi dobre sedia a chcem zostať fit každodenným cvičením.

words.definition: At a fast speed or in a short time.
words.example_en: She quickly finished her homework.
words.example_sk: Rýchlo dokončila domácu úlohu.

words.definition: A feeling of loyalty, enthusiasm, and cooperation among members of a team.
words.example_en: Good team spirit helps people work better together.
words.example_sk: Dobrý tímový duch pomáha ľuďom lepšie spolupracovať.

words.definition: A person who makes sure the rules are followed in a game or sports match.
words.example_en: The referee stopped the match after the foul.
words.example_sk: Rozhodca zastavil zápas po faule.

words.definition: A large building or open area with seats where people watch sports and other events.
words.example_en: Thousands of fans filled the stadium for the final match.
words.example_sk: Tisíce fanúšikov zaplnili štadión na finálový zápas.

words.definition: A person who leads a team, a ship, or a group of people.
words.example_en: The captain led the team to victory.
words.example_sk: Kapitán doviedol tím k víťazstvu.

words.definition: To do something repeatedly in order to improve a skill, or the activity of doing this regularly.
words.example_en: You need to practice every day if you want to play the piano well.
words.example_sk: Musíš cvičiť každý deň, ak chceš dobre hrať na klavíri.

words.definition: A number showing the result of a game or test; also, to gain points or achieve a result.
words.example_en: She scored the winning goal, and the final score was 2–1.
words.example_sk: Strelila víťazný gól a konečné skóre bolo 2:1.

words.definition: Wanting to be more successful than others, or related to competition.
words.example_en: She is very competitive and always wants to win.
words.example_sk: Je veľmi súťaživá a vždy chce vyhrať.

words.definition: Having or showing a lot of energy and enthusiasm.
words.example_en: She is very energetic and always ready to help.
words.example_sk: Je veľmi energická a vždy je pripravená pomôcť.

words.definition: To a moderate degree; quite, but not very. It can also mean in a just and reasonable way.
words.example_en: The test was fairly easy.
words.example_sk: Test bol pomerne ľahký.

words.definition: To prepare your body or voice for exercise or performance by doing gentle activities first.
words.example_en: Always warm up before you start running.
words.example_sk: Predtým, ako začneš behať, sa vždy rozcvič.

words.definition: To join in an activity or event.
words.example_en: Many students take part in the school competition every year.
words.example_sk: Mnohí študenti sa každý rok zúčastňujú školskej súťaže.

words.definition: A person who watches an event, game, or performance.
words.example_en: Every spectator cheered when the team scored.
words.example_sk: Každý divák jasal, keď tím strelil gól.

words.definition: To protect someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism.
words.example_en: Soldiers defend their country.
words.example_sk: Vojaci bránia svoju krajinu.

words.definition: hurt or physically harmed
words.example_en: The injured player was taken to the hospital.
words.example_sk: Zraneného hráča odviezli do nemocnice.

words.definition: In a way that shows attention, caution, and effort to avoid mistakes or danger.
words.example_en: She carefully checked the details before sending the email.
words.example_sk: Pred odoslaním e-mailu si opatrne skontrolovala detaily.

words.definition: To achieve the best, fastest, highest, or most successful result ever recorded in a particular activity.
words.example_en: She set a record in the 100-meter race.
words.example_sk: V behu na 100 metrov vytvorila rekord.

words.definition: A group of sports teams or clubs that compete against each other in a season or competition.
words.example_en: Their team won the league last year.
words.example_sk: Ich tím minulý rok vyhral ligu.

words.definition: To become better, or to make something better.
words.example_en: She wants to improve her English before the exam.
words.example_sk: Pred skúškou si chce zlepšiť angličtinu.

words.definition: Having a natural ability to do something well.
words.example_en: She is a talented musician.
words.example_sk: Je talentovaná hudobníčka.

words.definition: At fixed times or intervals, or in a consistent way.
words.example_en: She exercises regularly to stay healthy.
words.example_sk: Pravidelne cvičí, aby zostala zdravá.

words.definition: To find an answer by thinking; to develop in a particular way; or to exercise physically.
words.example_en: We need to work out how much the trip will cost.
words.example_sk: Musíme vyriešiť, koľko bude ten výlet stáť.

words.definition: An important competition to find the best player or team in a sport or other activity.
words.example_en: Their team won the national championship last year.
words.example_sk: Ich tím minulý rok vyhral národné majstrovstvo.

words.definition: A person who is responsible for controlling or organizing part or all of a company or similar organization.
words.example_en: The manager called a meeting to discuss the new project.
words.example_sk: Manažér zvolal stretnutie, aby prediskutoval nový projekt.

words.definition: A person who competes against or disagrees with another person.
words.example_en: She defeated her opponent in the final match.
words.example_sk: Vo finálovom zápase porazila svoju súperku.

words.definition: Physical activity done to improve health and fitness, or the act of using something such as a skill or power.
words.example_en: Regular exercise is good for your health.
words.example_sk: Pravidelné cvičenie je dobré pre tvoje zdravie.

words.definition: To become healthy again after illness or injury, or to get back something that was lost.
words.example_en: It took her several weeks to recover from the flu.
words.example_sk: Trvalo jej niekoľko týždňov, kým sa zotavila z chrípky.

words.definition: Having made a firm decision and being strongly motivated to do something.
words.example_en: She was determined to finish the project on time.
words.example_sk: Bola odhodlaná dokončiť projekt načas.

words.definition: Extremely tired; having no energy left.
words.example_en: After working all day, she felt completely exhausted.
words.example_sk: Po celodennej práci sa cítila úplne vyčerpaná.

words.definition: In a gradual, regular, and continuous way without sudden changes.
words.example_en: Her English has improved steadily over the past year.
words.example_sk: Jej angličtina sa za posledný rok stabilne zlepšovala.

words.definition: Before a particular time or event.
words.example_en: Please let me know in advance if you cannot come.
words.example_sk: Prosím, daj mi vedieť vopred, ak nemôžeš prísť.

words.definition: Sitting on a bench, or not actively playing in a game and waiting as a substitute.
words.example_en: He sat on the bench and watched the match.
words.example_sk: Sedel na lavičke a pozeral zápas.

words.definition: The player in sports such as football or hockey whose job is to stop the other team from scoring goals.
words.example_en: The goalkeeper saved the penalty.
words.example_sk: Brankár chytil penaltu.

words.definition: To use or put one person or thing in place of another; a person or thing used instead of another.
words.example_en: You can substitute butter with olive oil in this recipe.
words.example_sk: V tomto recepte môžeš nahradiť maslo olivovým olejom.

words.definition: A person who supports, helps, or agrees with someone or something.
words.example_en: She is a strong supporter of the new education reform.
words.example_sk: Je silnou podporovateľkou novej reformy školstva.

words.definition: To move a ball by bouncing or tapping it repeatedly while running or walking; also to let liquid or saliva fall in small drops.
words.example_en: She can dribble the basketball past three defenders.
words.example_sk: Dokáže driblovať s basketbalovou loptou popri troch obrancoch.

words.definition: To make something longer or wider by pulling it; to extend your body or a part of it; also, a continuous area or period of something.
words.example_en: She stretched her arms above her head after waking up.
words.example_sk: Po prebudení si natiahla ruky nad hlavu.

words.definition: Having different parts or elements in the correct proportions; stable and not extreme.
words.example_en: A balanced diet is important for good health.
words.example_sk: Vyvážená strava je dôležitá pre dobré zdravie.

words.definition: Having a strong reason to do something and being enthusiastic about it.
words.example_en: She is highly motivated to learn new skills.
words.example_sk: Je veľmi motivovaná naučiť sa nové zručnosti.

words.definition: In a way that is careful, thorough, or with very little distance in space or relationship.
words.example_en: Please listen closely to the instructions.
words.example_sk: Prosím, počúvajte pozorne pokyny.

words.definition: To stop trying to do something or to surrender.
words.example_en: Don't give up; you can still finish the race.
words.example_sk: Nevzdávaj sa; stále môžeš dokončiť preteky.

words.definition: At the arranged or expected time; not late.
words.example_en: The train arrived on time.
words.example_sk: Vlak prišiel načas.
